obligation: FAR 52.204-21 Basic Safeguarding of Covered Contractor Information Systems
basis: The clause is in FC-1, FC-2 and FC-3. Company systems process, store and transmit FCI for those contracts (drawings, submittals, daily logs, pay apps, certified payrolls), so they are covered contractor information systems (52.204-21(a)). No size exemption; the COTS exclusion does not fit construction contracts. New awards under a FAR Part 40 class deviation carry the same 15 requirements as FAR 52.240-93

obligation: FAR 52.204-25 Section 889 prohibition (covered telecom/video surveillance equipment)
basis: The clause is in FC-1, FC-2 and FC-3. The security systems group installs cameras, recorders, access control and network switches in federal buildings, so the (b)(1) prohibition on providing covered equipment is operational; (b)(2) bars use in the company's own operations. No size exemption

obligation: DFARS 252.204-7012 Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
applies: No (clause present in FC-3; not triggered)
basis: FC-3 includes the clause, but its duties attach to systems that hold covered defense information, and none has been marked, identified or provided in the contract documents

obligation: CMMC Program rule (32 CFR Part 170) and DFARS 252.204-7021
applies: Yes (from the first DoD award that carries 252.204-7021; readiness assessed now)
basis: None of FC-1 to FC-3 carries 252.204-7021, because they were awarded before Phase 1 began on 2025-11-10. The DoD solicitation expected in 2026 Q4 is expected to require Level 1 (Self) for FCI (32 CFR 170.15(b)). FC-3 has option periods, and DoD may require Level 1 (Self) to exercise an option (170.3(e)(1)). No size exemption

obligation: NIST SP 800-171 R2 and CMMC Level 2 (CUI)
basis: No CUI is held or identified in the contract files. Any decision on future CUI work is recorded in the P03 escalation plan

obligation: Covered telecommunications representations (SAM) and offeror representation
basis: The company keeps an active SAM registration with annual representations, renewed in March 2026

obligation: Federal payment clauses: progress payments, prompt payment of subcontractors, EFT to the SAM account
basis: The clauses are in the federal contracts. Subcontractors must be paid within 7 days of receipt, and a payment sent to incorrect EFT information the contractor supplied in SAM is the contractor's loss (52.232-33(e)(2))
The clause is in the federal construction contracts; weekly certified payrolls are produced in the payroll system

obligation: Federal pricing rules that touch AI-assisted bids: independent price determination, certified cost or pricing data, small business subcontracting policy
applies: Yes (52.203-2 and 52.219-8 on federal bids and jobs); 15.403-4 when required
basis: The company bids federal work and an AI tool is used in estimating
The company holds personal information of Florida residents: employee names with Social Security numbers and bank accounts in the payroll system

obligation: HIPAA Privacy, Security and Breach Notification Rules
basis: The company is a general contractor, not a covered entity. The VA clinic and hospital office building contracts concern construction documents only and include no business associate agreement

citation: PCI Security Standards Council standard (contractual, not law)
basis: No card payments are accepted; owners pay by ACH, wire or EFT
The company is a privately held LLC with no registered securities

obligation: State AI laws (for example Colorado SB26-189)
basis: All 8 active jobs and the main office are in Florida, and the AI tool makes no consequential decisions about individuals. Out of scope by decision
